warnings.headline: Ice, yellow level, Lowland areas and valleys in southeastern Norway, 2026-11-06T15:00:00+00:00, 2026-11-09T10:00:00+00:00
warnings.description: There is risk of glaze ice, due to widespread freezing fog and occasional freezing drizzle. The fog and drizzle is freezing on the ground, as well as on vehicles and other objects. In the middle of the day Saturday and Sunday there may locally be less fog, the temperature may locally be above freezing point, and the danger may thus decrease temporarily.
warnings.instruction: Locally difficult driving conditions: Allow extra time for travel and driving. Use correct tires and drive according to the conditions. Follow the updates: Stay updated on weather warnings. Check road conditions at vegvesen.no/trafikk.
areas: Lowland areas and valleys in southeastern Norway
